profile.headline: Senior Embedded Software Engineer at Persistent Systems, LLC

positions.title: Linear Algebra & Engineering Programming Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
-Assist faculty members with classroom instructions, labs and various record keeping such as grading
-Hold office hours to provide assistance to students with homework, MATLAB programming, labs and classroom topics

positions.title: Summer Engineering Aide
positions.description:
-Team Lead for an equipment conversion program that replaced mechanical steam metering equipment with electronic equipment
    -Conducted field visits with electrical contractors and environmental safety inspectors to confirm electrical routes to power the new electronic meters
    -Led weekly meetings with electrical contractors and Con Edison ground crew, who replaced the meters, to coordinate work between the two groups
    -Contacted customers in order to plan out the electrical work necessary to power the new meters in addition to gathering all necessary information and paperwork

-Designed equipment for Con Edison ground crew
    -Designed and produced printed circuit boards that indicated if a meter lost power since the last meter reading, allowing meter readers to accurately determine meter functionality
    -Created, programmed microcontrollers in C++ and assembled meter calibration equipment used to conduct NYS mandated calibration tests
    -Developed a mobile app using Java to wirelessly, via Bluetooth, access steam monitoring equipment located underground without requiring ground crews to open up a manhole

-Conducted integrity tests in which electrical equipment boxes were submerged underwater to measure their effectiveness in Hurricane Sandy level flooding
